units: <cite ref="Sukkah 8a:2">Succ. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>כמה מרובע יותר על הע׳</he> by how much is a square larger than a tangent circle within it? One fourth; Ohol. XII, 6.

<cite ref="Nazir 8b:11">Naz. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>בֵּית עי׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בית עגול</he>) a circular building; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:3">Tosef. Neg. VI, 3</cite> <he>בית העגיל</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>העגל</he>).

senses.gloss: a round mould in which figs or grapes are pressed, cake of pressed figs; cake, loaf.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:1">B. Mets. II, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 21a:9">21ᵃ</cite>) <he>מצא ע׳ ובתוכו וכ׳</he> if one finds a cake of figs within which was a piece of earthen ware (as a mark).

<cite ref="Shabbat 93a:1">Sabb. 93ᵃ</cite> top (expl. <cite ref="K00663"><he>ככר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:5">ib. X, 5</cite>) <he>בע׳ של דבילה</he> a cake of figs (too large for one to carry); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עִיגּוּלִים</he>, <he>עִיגּוּלִין</he>, <cite ref="P00497"><he>עִגּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:3:17">Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵈ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 10:8">Toh. X, 8</cite> <he>בין הע׳ לזונין</he> the space between the moulds and the deposit of grape shells (Maim.; v. infra).—

<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 6">Ab. d’R. N. ch. VI</cite>, end <he>היו מביאין את הע׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>העגלים</he>, v. ed. Schechter note) they took the loaves of bread and sawed them apart and soiled them with mud.

senses.gloss: עִיגּוּלֵי הגת, עִגּ׳ weights (clay cylinders) put on the wine press.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:9">Sabb. I, 9</cite> <he>טוענין … ע׳ הגת</he> you may put on (the press) the beams of the oil press or the cylinders of the wine press; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:29">Tosef. ib. I, 29</cite> <he>ותולין בע׳ הגת</he> (Var. <he>ע׳ הגת</he>) and suspend the weights &c. Toh. l. c. <he>בין ע׳ לזוגין</he> between the cylinders &c. (R. S.; v. supra).
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 5:8">Tosef. Mikv. V, 8</cite> <he>עגולי שלג</he> lumps of snow; a. fr.
